description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TEST ENGINEERING AND OPERATIONS 

 We are seeking a Software Engineer with strong professional Python and Linux experience to design, develop, and continuously improve software that keeps vehicles and spacecraft buildable, testable, and flyable. This role sits between physical hardware (flight sensors, instrumentation, and checkout equipment) and test and manufacturing operations. You will wrangle large amounts of data and use modern deployment practices to streamline hardware checkout and quality control, simplify test operations, ensure procedure traceability, and reduce recurring operational risk.

 As a Software Engineer on the Test Engineering and Operations team, you will drive continuous improvement while eliminating recurring engineering and operational tasks. You will work directly with SpaceX engineers to discover their needs, rapidly learn new technologies and domains, and apply engineering judgment to build highly reliable, data-driven software. You will own the complete lifecycle of the software you create, including development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. You are the engineer other engineers can count on: technical, proactive, and focused on solving tomorrow’s problems today.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:  

 
 Develop, maintain, streamline, and troubleshoot Python-based analysis tools, data pipelines, enterprise applications, automated tests, and software systems that support hardware checkout, test operations, and vehicle processing

 Design, implement, and deploy reliable software that interface with physical systems and instrumentation (such as resistance temperature detectors, pressure transducers, and other sensors)

 Design, develop, review, and deploy software using modern continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines and Linux environments

 Evaluate existing tools and processes and implement more efficient, scalable, and reliable approaches, including refactoring and automation

 Create interdisciplinary software solutions that optimize engineering time, eliminate recurring tasks, streamline workflows, and reduce risk for hazardous operations

 Develop sustainable, scalable, and secure software systems following object-oriented principles while rapidly learning and integrating new technologies as needed

 Participate and provide meaningful feedback in architecture, design, and code reviews in a dynamic environment

 
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:  

 
 Bachelor’s degree in an engineering, math, or scientific discipline OR 1+ years' professional experience coding in an object-oriented language (including internships, design/build/compete project teams)

 Minimum of 1+ years of professional software development experience with Python

 
 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:  

 
 Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies, wrangle data, and deliver reliable solutions in dynamic and uncertain environments

 ⁠Familiarity with physical systems and hardware such as RTDs, pressure transducers, and other common aerospace instrumentation

 Strong skills in developing strategies to collect and use large amounts of data for efficiency and reliability improvements (e.g. SQL, databases, and related tools)

 Familiar with CI/CD pipelines and deployment systems

 ⁠Experience working in Linux environments, including shell scripting, system administration, and deploying applications on Linux-based systems

 Familiar with networking technology, concepts, protocols, and infrastructure

 Strong competency in software development practices including testing, continuous integration, and modern deployment workflows

 Ability to quickly and competently pick up new skills and develop expertise in unfamiliar domains

 Ability to thrive in uncertain, dynamic, and high-pressure environments with rapidly changing needs and requirements

 Strong skills in debugging, performance optimization, and writing reliable, testable code

 Able to prioritize and execute tasks while maintaining an ongoing drive for continuous improvement

 Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) with the ability to succinctly present recommendations to stakeholders, customers, and management

 Able to work effectively in an integrated collaborative team environment, including frequent interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers

 Passion for advancing the commercial space industry and human spaceflight

 
 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:     
    
Pay range:    
Level I: $125,000.00 - $145,000.00/per year    
Level II: $145,000.00 - $175,000.00/per year    

 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

 Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.
 ITAR REQUIREMENTS: 

 
 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .  

 
 SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

 Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to  EEOCompliance@spacex.com .
